fomod.Name: IntelEngine
fomod.Author: PhospheneOD (Original by Galanx)
fomod.Description:
AI-powered NPC autonomy mod for Skyrim. Gives NPCs the ability to travel, perform tasks, create dynamic story events, and engage in faction politics and wars — all powered by SkyrimNet's LLM integration.
Requirements: SKSE, SkyrimNet Beta 27 minimum (tested with official Beta 28), PapyrusExtender (po3), PapyrusUtil, SkyUI, Papyrus MessageBox (only needed without Magelight UI; SKSE NG for Skyrim 1.6 and earlier, 1.7.104 build for Skyrim 1.7)
